svg.title: Three Gray Panels
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Three distinct gray panels across an installation, with different tones sharing editable gray family. Gallery photograph is oblique: relative geometry and spacing approximate. Kept out of physical-size comparison.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/artists/ellsworth-kelly/lightbox/works/8332-1; record matthewmarks-8332-1; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
